answer: Use reputation escrow with slashing. A new agent posts a 500-token bond into escrow and trades only after three established agents vouch for it, each risking 100 tokens. Every deal leaves a signed receipt, and a confirmed cheat burns the bond plus the vouchers' stakes, while the fraud signal spreads so a whisper of bad behaviour reaches every market before the cheat can re-register. Running 1,000 fake agents costs 500,000 tokens in bonds plus 300,000 in voucher stakes, about $160,000 at $0.20 a token. Like a nebula of street vendors who only rent a stall to someone a neighbour trusts.
